profile.name: SHFQA量子分析仪
profile.description: 这是一台 Zurich Instruments 的 SHFQA 量子分析仪，用于量子测量实验中的读出脉冲生成、采集控制、加权积分、DIO 触发联动以及谱学配置。驱动表明该设备支持测量序列上传、外部时钟锁定、采集单元控制、积分权重配置和串扰校正，常用于超导量子比特读出与相关表征实验。
profile.description_en: This is a Zurich Instruments SHFQA quantum analyzer used in quantum measurement experiments for readout pulse generation, acquisition control, weighted integration, DIO-triggered coordination, and spectroscopy setup. The driver indicates support for sequencer program upload, external clock locking, acquisition unit control, integration weight configuration, and crosstalk correction, making it suitable for superconducting qubit readout and related characterization experiments.
